grid_api.recorded: Each cell is a `Cell { c: char, fg: Color, bg: Color, flags: Flags, extra: Option<Vec<char>> }`; Flags has BOLD, ITALIC, UNDERLINE, INVERSE, WIDE_CHAR and WIDE_CHAR_SPACER; `extra` holds combining marks. `grid.row(i)` returns a row by index, including rows in history.

kitty_graphics.recorded: Implements Kitty transmit and direct placement.
